hypothesis: Separate current task progress from scheduler waiting, and admit recovered GPU sets after a fresh verified NCCL probe without renewing task failure caps.

issues: Idle control processes reused rank records after their task ended.
A restarted task reused old records from before the current process started.
Persistent place exclusion and node quarantine had no verified same-GPU recovery path, including native recovery jobs already migrated back to pending.

fixtures_corrected: Compare retained attempts/task, not queue bookkeeping added by original bounded recovery.
RPC fixture assertion was initially attached to the wrong test; corrected before committing.

rules.node_reentry: Fresh original four-GPU NCCL admission required; verify passed receipt before allowing same-place retries.
rules.task_failure_caps: Original lifetime caps and evaluation replay caps retained.
rules.probe_limit: At most two failed/interrupted probes per GPU/binding/controller; successful recovery followed by a native crash stops further recovery.
rules.NO_PROGRESS: 120 seconds without a new record from a live task; display only, no automatic kill or retry.
